svg.title: lastbite-swiggy-mcp
svg.desc: Agent · MCP. 3 confirmation gates. Order food from Swiggy in plain English. The agent builds the cart over Swiggy's MCP server, then three confirmation gates and a 30-second grace timer stand between it and your order. Built with TypeScript, Next.js, LangGraph, MCP, Redis.

g.text: Order food from Swiggy in plain English. The agent builds the cart
over Swiggy's MCP server, then three confirmation gates and a
30-second grace timer stand between it and your order.
